_meta.generatedBy: Claude Opus 4.7 — 수업 자료용 프롬프트만 박음 (실제 이미지 생성 X)

policy.level1: 정돈 — 선·색만 정리. 캐릭터 위치/구도/배경 배치/손그림 느낌 유지.
policy.level2: 발전 — 캐릭터 정체성/핵심 구도 유지하면서 배경·디테일·완성도 풍부화.

_meta.consistencyNote: 21장 전체에서 마루(시민 1)·하루(시민 2)·토토·모찌·뇨뇨 기사·수영 뇨뇨·뇨뇨왕·몽실이·무진·멧돼지·밀렵꾼 박힌 캐릭터 박힘. 장면 사이 캐릭터 모습·작품 분위기(따뜻한 손그림 + sketch-note 테마) 일관성 유지 필수.

characters.마루·하루: 두 명의 어린 시민. 학생이 박은 모습 그대로 유지 — 옷·머리·표정 일관
characters.토토: 작은 동물 친구 (정확한 종은 원본 그림 박은 거 그대로)

globalPromptHeader_level1: Edit this children's storybook scene drawn by an elementary school student. Keep the student's hand-drawn feeling, line quality, and character positions exactly as they are. Only clean up smudges, fill small gaps in coloring, and slightly sharpen blurry areas. Do NOT redraw, do NOT change the composition, do NOT add new characters or objects, do NOT make it look like polished digital art. The result should feel like the same drawing, just a little tidier — as if a careful adult helped neaten the page after the child finished. Maintain warm pastel tones and paper texture. Korean children's storybook style.
globalPromptHeader_level2: Develop this children's storybook scene drawn by an elementary school student into a slightly richer illustration, while keeping the student's core identity. Preserve: the main characters' identity, their positions and relationships, the overall composition, key objects, and the warm hand-drawn feeling. You MAY: enrich the background slightly, add small atmospheric details (light, shadow, simple textures), make character expressions a bit clearer, balance the color palette across scenes. Do NOT: replace the drawing with polished digital art, change character identities, alter the core composition, add events or characters not in the scene, make any single scene visually louder than others. The result should feel like the same student's story but with a more complete storybook quality. Korean children's storybook, warm and cohesive across all scenes.

scenes.sceneBody: 마루, 하루가 길을 가다 멧돼지에 쫓긴다. 도망가고 있는데 숲속에서 소리가 난다.
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Scene context: Maru and Haru are running on a forest path, being chased by a wild boar. A mysterious sound comes from deeper in the forest. Keep the student's drawing of the two characters' positions and the boar's pose exactly as they are. Only smooth out rough pencil marks, fill any color gaps in the characters' clothing, and slightly even out the green tones of the forest. The forest should remain a sketchy, warm hand-drawn green — not a photo-realistic forest. Maintain the chase tension as the student drew it.
doNotChange: 캐릭터 얼굴 표정 (학생이 박은 거 그대로)
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Scene context: Opening scene of the story. Maru and Haru, two young citizens, are running down a narrow forest path while a wild boar chases them from behind. From somewhere deeper in the forest, a strange sound is heard. Develop: add a hint of dappled light through the forest canopy, a few more trees in the distance to create depth, small motion lines behind the running characters to enhance the chase feeling. Keep the characters' faces, clothing, and the boar exactly as the student drew them — they are the protagonists and must remain consistent across all 21 scenes. The overall mood should be slightly tense but still warm and storybook-appropriate.
scenes.preserveCore: 두 시민 박힌 캐릭터 얼굴·옷·자세. 멧돼지 박힌 모습. 다른 20장면과의 시각적 연결.

scenes.sceneBody: 마루, 하루는 토토, 모찌를 만났다. 모찌는 밀렵꾼에게 쫓기고 있었다.
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Scene: Maru and Haru meet two new friends — Toto and Mochi. Mochi is being chased by a poacher. Keep all four character placements and the poacher's position exactly as drawn. Only smooth lines and balance colors. The poacher should remain a slightly scary but child-friendly figure as the student drew them.
doNotChange: 밀렵꾼의 표현 강도 (학생 박은 거 유지)
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Scene: A pivotal meeting — Maru and Haru meet Toto (a small animal friend) and Mochi (a fish friend). Mochi is being chased by a poacher. Develop: enrich the forest backdrop slightly to show the meeting place, add subtle expressions to show Mochi's fear and the protagonists' surprise. Maintain the four characters' identity exactly — Toto and Mochi will appear again in later scenes (5, 16) and must remain visually consistent. The poacher should stay scary-but-not-cruel, suitable for elementary readers.

scenes.sceneBody: 멧돼지에게 쫓기다 실종(마루, 하루)
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Scene: After being chased by the boar, Maru and Haru have become separated and lost in the forest. Keep the student's depiction of separation/loneliness exactly. Just clean lines and tone.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Scene: Maru and Haru are lost and separated deep in the forest. Develop: subtle hints of dim light to suggest "deeper" forest, a soft shadowy depth to enhance the lost feeling. Both characters must still be the same as scene 1 — same hair, same clothes.

scenes.sceneBody: 뇨뇨 기사를 만나서 악당을 물리친 뒤 시민 둘은 배가 너무 고팠다. 기사 뇨뇨는 옆에 있던 열매를 따줬다. 무슨 열매를 먹지?
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Scene: After defeating a villain together with Knight Nyonyo (뇨뇨 기사), the two citizens are very hungry. The knight picks two fruits from a nearby tree. Keep the knight's design, the two fruits' placement, and the characters' hungry expressions exactly as drawn. Clean only.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Scene: After Knight Nyonyo helped defeat a villain, the hungry citizens are offered two fruits from the knight — one that looks delicious (shiny), one that looks unappetizing (wilted). Develop: make the visual contrast between the two fruits slightly clearer (one bright and shiny, one dull) to support the choice the reader makes. The knight's identity must remain distinct from other Nyonyo characters (수영 뇨뇨 scene 13, 뇨뇨왕 scene 19).
scenes.preserveCore: 뇨뇨 기사 박힌 디자인 — 다른 뇨뇨들과 구별

scenes.sceneBody: 마루하루는 밀렵꾼에게 잡혀갔다!! 토토와 모찌도 잡혀갔다!!
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Ending scene: All four — Maru, Haru, Toto, Mochi — captured by the poacher. Keep the student's depiction of capture (bag, rope, or however drawn). Just clean lines.
doNotChange: 엔딩의 어두운 분위기 (학생이 박은 정도 그대로)
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Sad ending: The poacher has captured all four characters. Develop: a subtle quiet mood — perhaps fading light to suggest end of day, but not too dark for a children's book. The poacher must remain visually consistent with scene 2.

scenes.sceneBody: 하루마루는 서로 만났다! 멧돼지를 무찔러야 한다! 무슨 공격을 할까? 시민 두명의 가방에는 막대자와 필통이 있었다. 뭘 고를까?
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Scene: Maru and Haru reunite. They must fight the boar. Their bags contain a ruler (막대자) and a pencil case (필통). Keep the items, the reunion pose, and the boar's threatening position exactly.
mustKeep: 막대자·필통 박힌 모습 (학생 박은 거 — 일반 학용품)
doNotChange: 학생 박은 일상 아이템의 친근한 모습
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Reunion scene: Maru and Haru finally meet again. The boar from scene 1 has returned. In their bags: a ruler and a pencil case — funny everyday school items as weapons. Develop: the reunion can have a small joyful expression on both faces, and the boar can look slightly more menacing. Keep the everyday-school-items as cute/funny tools, not real weapons.

scenes.sceneBody: 결국 흩어진다....
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Sad ending: The two are permanently separated. Keep the student's depiction of separation.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Sad ending: Maru and Haru drift apart in the forest forever. Develop: a soft fading effect between the two figures, a quiet melancholy tone. Still children's book appropriate — sad but not despairing.

scenes.sceneBody: 맛있어 보이는 열매는 독이 있었다!
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Ending: The shiny delicious-looking fruit turned out to be poisonous. Keep the visual of the fruit and the reaction of the characters.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Ending: The shiny fruit had poison. Develop: a subtle visual hint of the fruit turning suspicious (maybe a small purple aura or wilting). Characters' faces show shock but stay child-appropriate. The fruit must match its appearance in scene 4.

scenes.sceneBody: 맛없어 보이는 열매는 배도 채워지고, 투명인간이 10분간 된다. 이제 어디로 가지?
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Scene: The unappetizing fruit was actually magical — fills bellies and makes the characters invisible for 10 minutes. Keep the invisibility effect as the student drew it (perhaps outlines, transparency).
doNotChange: 투명화의 학생적 표현 (단순한 흰색 또는 outline)
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Scene: The unappetizing fruit had magic — bellies full, invisible for 10 minutes. Develop: a clearer invisibility effect (translucent body outlines, subtle shimmer), and a hint of two paths in the background to suggest the upcoming choice (mountain vs Nyonyo village).

scenes.sceneBody: 마루하루는 맷돼지를 무찌르고 집으로 돌아가 행복하게 살았답니다.
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Happy ending: Maru and Haru defeat the boar and return home happy. Keep the joyful expressions and the home as the student drew them.
doNotChange: 집 박힌 학생적 그림 (전형적 어린이 그림 집)
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Classic happy ending: Maru and Haru defeated the boar and returned home to live happily. Develop: warm golden lighting, a cozy home backdrop with small comforting details (window, smoke from chimney perhaps). Keep the child-drawn home shape — do not replace with a polished house.

scenes.sceneBody: 멧돼지에게 필통을 던지려고 보니 몽실이가 구해달라고 소리쳤다! 몽실이는 무진에게 쫒기고 있었다! 어떻게 하지??
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Scene: Just as the characters are about to throw a pencil case at the boar, Mongsil (another animal friend) cries out for help — she's being chased by Mujin. Keep all character placements exactly.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Scene: A new conflict arrives — Mongsil cries "Help me!" while being chased by Mujin. Develop: clearer expressions of Mongsil's fear and Mujin's pursuit. Both characters will appear again in scenes 14 and 18 — their designs must stay consistent.

scenes.sceneBody: 결국 숲에 깊은 늪에 빠져서 나오지 못했다.
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Sad ending: The characters fell into a deep swamp in the forest. Keep the swamp as drawn.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Sad ending: Trapped in a deep forest swamp. Develop: a slightly murky atmosphere, soft bubbles maybe — but not horrific. Children's book appropriate sadness.

scenes.sceneBody: 수영 뇨뇨가 자신은 물고기를 구하러 가야한다고 한다. 하지만 수영 뇨뇨는 다른 뇨뇨보다 작다. 도와줄까?
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Scene: Swimming Nyonyo (수영 뇨뇨) needs to save a fish but is smaller than other Nyonyos. Keep the small Nyonyo's size as drawn.
mustKeep: 수영 뇨뇨의 작은 크기 (다른 뇨뇨들 대비)
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Scene: Swimming Nyonyo asks for help — needs to save a fish but is much smaller than the other Nyonyos. Develop: clearer size contrast, perhaps water/river hint in the background to set up the rescue context. 수영 뇨뇨 must be visually distinct from 뇨뇨 기사 (scene 4) and 뇨뇨왕 (scene 19) — same species, different individuals.
scenes.preserveCore: 수영 뇨뇨 design — 다른 뇨뇨들과 구별

scenes.sceneBody: 몽실이가 무진에게 화해하자고 말해서 화해했다. 그래서 무진이가 멧돼지를 없앴다! 무진이와 몽실이가 사는 곳으로 갈까? 무진이와 몽실이를 데려갈까?
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Scene: Mongsil and Mujin reconcile, then Mujin defeats the boar. Keep all characters as drawn.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Scene: A peaceful resolution — Mongsil and Mujin make up, and Mujin defeats the boar together. Develop: a warm friendly atmosphere among all characters. Mongsil and Mujin's design must match scene 11.

scenes.sceneBody: 모찌를 구하고 오니 수영 뇨뇨를 밀렵꾼이 쫒아온다! 어떻게 하지?
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Scene: After saving Mochi, now the poacher is chasing Swimming Nyonyo. Keep the chase composition.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Scene: After rescuing Mochi, the poacher reappears chasing Swimming Nyonyo. Develop: a sense of urgency in the chase. 수영 뇨뇨 must match scene 13. 밀렵꾼 must match scene 2.

scenes.sceneBody: 수영뇨뇨와 같이 가보니 물고기 모찌가 도와달라고 했다. 어떻게 도와주지? 모든 동물이 모여있다!
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Scene: All animals from earlier scenes have gathered — Mochi asks for help. Keep the gathering composition with as many recurring characters as the student drew.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Scene: A climactic gathering — all the animals (Toto, Mochi, Swimming Nyonyo, Mongsil, Mujin, etc.) are together, and Mochi calls for help. Develop: a warm sense of community despite the danger. CRITICAL: every recurring character (Toto from scene 2, Mochi from scenes 2/5, Swimming Nyonyo from scene 13, etc.) must match their earlier appearances exactly.

scenes.sceneBody: 마루하루는 다시 숲속으로 돌아가니 모두가 기다리고 있었다. 숲속에서 파티를 열며 맛있는 음식을 먹었답니다!
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Happy ending: Forest party — Maru, Haru, and all the animal friends celebrate with food. Keep the party composition.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Joyful party ending: Maru and Haru return to the forest where all friends wait. A big forest party with delicious food. Develop: warm evening light, a sense of celebration, lanterns or hanging decorations perhaps. All recurring characters must match earlier scenes.
scenes.preserveCore: 캐릭터 일관성 + 학생 박은 파티 박힌 톤

scenes.sceneBody: 몽실이와 무진이가 사는 곳에는 물이 없어서 목이 말라서 쓰러졌다.
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Sad ending: Mongsil and Mujin's home has no water — the characters collapse from thirst. Keep the dry environment as drawn.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Sad ending: In Mongsil and Mujin's home, no water exists, and the characters collapse from thirst. Develop: dry cracked earth texture, warm but harsh light. Sad but appropriate for children.

scenes.role: 엔딩 — 진엔딩 후보 (착해진 밀렵꾼 + 뇨뇨왕 상)
scenes.sceneBody: 밀렵꾼이 하루마루의 말을 듣고 착해졌다! 뇨뇨왕이 시민 둘에게 상을 내렸다
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Best ending: The poacher reformed, and the Nyonyo King awards the two citizens. Keep the king's design and the poacher's softer expression as drawn.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] The most uplifting ending: the poacher reformed after Maru/Haru's words, and Nyonyo King personally awarded the two citizens. Develop: regal warm atmosphere, a sense of justice and kindness. The poacher's transformation should be visible (softer face, kinder posture). 뇨뇨왕 must be visually distinct from 뇨뇨 기사 (scene 4) and 수영 뇨뇨 (scene 13) — same species, different individual.

scenes.sceneBody: 밀렵꾼에게 모두 당해내지 못해서 쓰려졌다!
scenes.prompt_level1: [GLOBAL_LEVEL1_HEADER] Sad ending: Everyone fell before the poacher's strength. Keep the depiction.
scenes.prompt_level2: [GLOBAL_LEVEL2_HEADER] Defeat ending: Everyone was overcome by the poacher. Develop: a quiet defeated mood — sad but not graphic, suitable for children. 밀렵꾼 must match scenes 2 and 15.

scenes.note: 표지 박은 거 imageData 박지 X. 표지 디자인은 다른 장면들과 일관된 톤으로 별도 박을 거. 강도 1·2 적용 대상에서 제외.

imageToolUsageGuide.title: 외부 AI 도구로 이미지 박는 방법 (사용자 참고)

tools.name: ChatGPT (DALL-E 3)
tools.level1_method: 원본 이미지 업로드 → '이 그림을 다시 그리지 말고 선과 색만 살짝 정돈해줘' + 위 prompt_level1 한국어 번역 박음. inpaint/edit 모드 박음.
tools.level2_method: 원본 이미지 업로드 → '구도와 캐릭터는 유지하고 배경만 풍부하게' + prompt_level2 박음. variations 박지 X (완전히 다른 그림 박을 수 있음).
tools.caveat: DALL-E 3는 캐릭터 일관성이 약함 — 21장 박을 때 같은 캐릭터로 박지 못할 수 있음.

tools.name: Google Imagen / Gemini
tools.level1_method: Imagen 3 edit 박은 거 박음. mask 박은 거 박은 후 prompt 박음.
tools.level2_method: 동일 + style reference 박음 — 작품의 첫 장면을 reference로 박은 후 나머지 20장 박음 (일관성 강화).
tools.caveat: 한국어 prompt 박은 거 박지만 영어 prompt가 더 정확함.

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.level1_method: /imagine + 원본 image URL + --iw 2 (image weight 높임) + prompt. --no redraw 박은 거 박지만 강력하게 박을 수도 있음.
tools.caveat: Midjourney는 손그림 느낌 박지 X — 박은 결과가 박은 게 박은 학생 그림 박은 거 박지 X.

tools.name: Stable Diffusion (SDXL) + img2img
tools.level1_method: denoising strength 0.3~0.4 박음 (낮게). 박은 거 박지만 원본 박은 거 박힘.
tools.level2_method: denoising strength 0.5~0.6 박음. ControlNet (canny edge) 박은 거 박으면 구도 완벽 유지.
tools.caveat: 기술 박은 거 박은 사람 박은 거 박은 거. 일반 교사가 박기 어려움.

tools.name: 추천 워크플로우 (간단)
tools.method: ChatGPT Plus 박은 거 — 원본 1장 박은 후 '21장의 그림책 박은 일관된 캐릭터 박는 거 박는 시리즈로 박아줘. 첫 장면 박은 거 박은 캐릭터 박은 거 그대로 박아야 해' 명시 박은 후 박는 게 박은 거. 실패하면 다시 박음 (각 장면 1~3회 박을 예상).

imageToolUsageGuide.outputNaming: 박은 이미지 파일은 'scene_{num}_ai_level{N}.png' 박은 형식으로 박은 후 같은 lesson-materials/숲속의-비밀-2026-05/ 폴더 박음. HTML 박은 거 자동으로 박은 자리 박음 (scene_{num}_ai_level1.png / scene_{num}_ai_level2.png).
